description: This file defines the Account class for SuiteCRM, extending the Company class and implementing EmailInterface. It manages account data, relationships, and methods for CRUD operations, data export, and interfacing with related modules.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Represents an account entity in SuiteCRM, including fields for account attributes, relationships, and methods for data handling and integration with the CRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Account object, including custom fields and email logic, and sets up field mappings.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the account's name for summary displays.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves linked Contact beans associated with this account.

methods.name: clear_account_case_relationship
methods.description: Clears the relationship between the account and specified case(s).

methods.name: remove_redundant_http
methods.description: Legacy method to remove redundant http:// prefix from website URL (currently deprecated).

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills additional list view fields, including assigned username.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail fields, such as parent account name and campaign name.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Provides data for list views, including address formatting.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause for generic search queries based on input string.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query for exporting account data with optional related data and ordering.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Prepares email notification body with account details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements specific interfaces, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Returns a query to find unlinked emails for this account.

methods.name: getProductsServicesPurchasedQuery
methods.description: Returns a query to retrieve products/services purchased related to this account.
